en: Sepia-toned postcard view of a rural valley with rolling hills, meadows, and forested slopes. Several large houses or small villas stand in the foreground and midground, with fields and scattered trees surrounding them. A modest church with a steeple is visible further back along the valley road. The printed caption at the top reads "Lauenstein. Schützenhaus. Villa Anna." indicating specific buildings in the scene. On the right edge there is vertical printer information.
